items.text: At the first equivalence point, all H+ ions from the first dissociation havereactedwithNaOH.

items.label: text
items.text: At the second equivalence point, all H+ions from both reactions have reacted (twice as many as at the first equivalence point).

items.label: text
items.text: Therefore,the volume of NaOH added at the second equivalence point is exactly twice that at the first equivalence point.
